title: Phoenix Grand Canyon Sedona Oak Creek Canyon Shared Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
On this 15‑hour tour from the Phoenix area, you’ll travel through beautiful Oak Creek Canyon—where you can browse local crafts if you wish—then stop for pictures of Sedona’s Red Rocks. Finally, you’ll reach Grand Canyon National Park and visit multiple viewpoints to admire the natural wonder.”

This version presents the itinerary in a logical order: the drive and activities first, photo stops next, then the Grand Canyon viewpoints last, for a clearer flow
